title: dep-scan report output
description: The document `depscan report --format json` writes on stdout: the saved scan directory's documents as one object. Paths in scanDir are absolute with / separators; inside the manifest and the findings, paths keep the scan-directory-relative form those schemas define, with scanDir as their root. A directory that cannot be loaded produces the error document instead of this one.

scanDir.description: The scan directory that was rendered, absolute and normalised, with / as the separator on every platform. It is the root the manifest's and findings' relative paths resolve against.

manifest.description: The scan directory's manifest document. Null when the directory holds none.

findings.description: The scan directory's findings, the array inside its depscan.findings.json.

expectations.description: The gate result the report evaluated: the decisions file, --fail-on, --baseline and --vex applied to the saved findings. Absent when the report had no decisions to evaluate.
